submitted.rationale: XRD shows the Ag-rich end (idx 0, 5) is mostly metallic Ag/Ag2O. The Sb-rich side (idx 12) is AgSbO3 pyrochlore (match to mp-540872 is 0.80). Among the three EQE measurements, idx 12 (Ag0.26Sb0.74) gave the highest value, 0.044%. Its neighbours on either side (idx 8: 0.013%, idx 19: 0.011%) were about 3–4x lower, so the peak lies near idx 12.
